title: Tart Raspberry Panna Cotta
description: A creamy Italian dessert made with fresh raspberries and a tangy tart crust.
instructions: Roll out the tart and place on a baking sheet. Bake for 10-12 minutes, or until lightly browned.
In a medium bowl, whisk together the raspberries and honey until well combined.
In a separate bowl, whip the cream until stiff peaks form.
Fold the whipped cream into the raspberry mixture until no white streaks remain.
Pour the mixture into the baked tart crust.
Chill in the refrigerator for at least 2 hours, or until set.
Drizzle with additional honey, if desired.
